hertz_sphere — DRIVE tacsim op

• Data kinds: scalar × scalar × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.hertz_sphere(F: 'float', R: 'float', Estar: 'float') -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import tacsim; tacsim.hertz_sphere(F: 'float', R: 'float', Estar: 'float') -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("hertz_sphere"))

Usage

> This operator's description has not been translated yet. The original text follows as it is.

剛体球(半径 R)を弾性半空間(複合弾性率 E*)に荷重 F で押し込む Hertz 接触の閉形式(Johnson 1985 §3)。

返り: a(接触半径 = (3FR/4E*)^{1/3})、delta(押し込み = a²/R)、p0(最大圧 = 3F/(2πa²))、pm(平均圧 = F/(πa²) = (2/3)p0)と入力 F・R・Estar。Raises ValueError: いずれかが ≤ 0 または非有限。
